# KM-185 — Design: agent confirmation page visual

**Lane:** design · **Complexity:** 1 · **Model:** claude-opus · **Depends on:** KM-134, KM-180 · **Serializes with:** none (KM-134 merged first; this ticket edits only its presentational files)
**Plan context (pinned):** [M1 plan](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/plans/2026-10-01-002-refactor-external-m1-thin-path-plan.md) · [contracts](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/contracts.md) · [roster and graph](https://github.com/aiur-team/khala/blob/reset/m1-external-plan/docs/build/m1/roster.md) · **Design spec:** `docs/design/khala-chat/RECREATION-SPEC.md` §1.4, §2, §13.3, §20
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.tsx` (markup and classes only; never `controller.ts` or `ports.ts`), `apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/agent-confirm.css` (create or replace), `apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.test.tsx` (selector updates and the new visual assertions).

## Outcome

`/agent/confirm?joinId=…` renders as the design's centered **agent-finish card** (`reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-{dark,light}-agent-finish.png`, `fullbleed-390-*-agent-finish.png`) on a full-viewport `--bg-2` page, with the Khala brand row at the top left:

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Eyebrow | "KHALA" |
| Harness chip | logo + "Claude Code" or "Codex" |
| Large name | the agent label |
| Subline | "wants to join **{channel}**" |
| Action | the state's action (below) |

The four KM-134 states map onto the card:

| State | Action |
|---|---|
| Review | **Confirm** primary |
| Connecting | spinner + "Keep this tab open" |
| Done | green check line + **Open channel** |
| Error | the error copy + **Retry** where KM-134 offers it |

The copy is exactly KM-134's.

## Context and evidence

- **Template:** the design's `.kh-fin` card (`docs/design/khala-chat/source/Aiur Dashboard.html:4484` markup, `:729-737` CSS). Spec §13.3 gives the verbatim CSS and §20 the mapping.
- **KM-134 states and copy:** `docs/build/m1/tickets/KM-134.md` Steps 8 (harness names, review, connecting, done and error copy; "Copy never says 'room' or 'chat'"). Its files: `apps/web/src/features/agent-confirm/{ports.ts,controller.ts,AgentConfirm.tsx,…}`.
- **Fonts:** the operator directive (spec §2.1). All text is Space Grotesk or JetBrains Mono. Bungee is used **only** for the brand wordmark.

## Scope

1. Wrap the page in `<div class="khala-app" data-theme={theme}>` (KM-180's root, so tokens and fonts apply). Put the brand row `div.kh-brand` (KM-180 markup, wordmark plus theme toggle; no list, no Live badge) at the top left, followed by `div.kh-fin.kh-fin--page`.
2. Render the card as in spec §20. The exact DOM per state:
   - **review:**
     ```html
     <div class="kh-fin-c"><span class="kh-fin-eb">Khala</span><span class="kh-mchip"><img src={logo} alt="">{harnessName}</span><h1 class="kh-fin-n">{label}</h1><p class="kh-fin-p">wants to join <b>{channelName}</b></p><button type="button" class="kh-btn pri">Confirm</button></div>
     ```
     Keep KM-134's sentence for screen readers: the visible text above composes "<label> (<harness name>) wants to join <channelName>."
   - **connecting:** `<span class="kh-spin" aria-hidden="true"></span><p class="kh-fin-p" role="status">Connecting {label}… Keep this tab open.</p>`
   - **done:** `<span class="kh-fin-ok">{check icon}{label} joined {channelName}.</span><a class="kh-btn pri" href={roomHref}>Open channel</a>`
   - **error:** `<p class="kh-fin-p kh-fin-err" role="alert">{KM-134 copy}</p>`, plus `<button class="kh-btn">Retry</button>` for `ready_timeout`, `invite_failed` and `unavailable`
   - Without a view (for example `not_found`), omit the chip and name, and show `<h1 class="kh-fin-n">Agent confirmation</h1>` plus the error.
3. CSS in `agent-confirm.css`:
   - §13.3 `.kh-fin*` verbatim
   - §20 `h1.kh-fin-n{margin:0}`, `.kh-fin-p`/`.kh-fin-ok`/`.kh-fin-err`/`a.kh-btn`
   - `.kh-fin--page { position: fixed; inset: 0; }` and `.kh-fin--page + * {}` (none)
   - `.khala-app > .kh-brand { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; z-index: 41; }`
   - **No close button** (`.kh-fin-x` is not rendered)
   - `.kh-mchip`, `.kh-btn`, `.kh-spin` come from KM-180's `controls.css`/`khala-app.css`
4. The heading is `h1.kh-fin-n` (1.45rem/700, Space Grotesk). It must not use Bungee.
5. Light and dark both work through `data-theme` (KM-180 `resolveInitialTheme`).

## Non-goals

- Behaviour, polling, invite, routing and signed-out redirect: **KM-134** (the redirect is generalized by **KM-187**).
- The brand row component: **KM-180** (reuse it).
- Any API or contract change.

## Contract and invariants

C2 (contracts.md, quoted):

```ts
export type AgentJoinView = { joinId: string; label: string; harness: Harness; channelName: string; roomId: string;
  state: 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'ready' | 'expired'; agentUserId?: string };
```

Harness names (KM-134): `claude` → "Claude Code", `codex` → "Codex".

## Implementation pointers

### Files

**Modify:** `features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.tsx`, `features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.test.tsx`

**Create or replace:** `features/agent-confirm/agent-confirm.css`

### Worked example

The view `{ label:'Claude', harness:'claude', channelName:'Launch', state:'pending', … }` in review renders an eyebrow `KHALA`, the chip `Claude Code`, a 1.45rem `Claude`, the line `wants to join Launch`, and a full-width 44px blue **Confirm** button. At 1440×900 the card is 340px wide, centred, with 20px radius and `--shadow-lg`.

### Steps

1. Restyle the markup per state (step 2 of **Scope**). Keep every `role`, accessible name and test ID KM-134 asserts.
2. Write the CSS.
3. Update the tests. Compare with `reference/screens/fullbleed-1440-{dark,light}-agent-finish.png` for the card geometry.

## Test scenarios

`features/agent-confirm/AgentConfirm.test.tsx` (keep all KM-134 cases green, and add):
1. Review renders `.kh-fin-c` holding `.kh-fin-eb` "Khala", `.kh-mchip` "Claude Code" and `h1.kh-fin-n` "Claude".
2. The **Confirm** button has classes `kh-btn pri`.
3. Connecting renders `.kh-spin` and `role="status"` text ending "Keep this tab open."
4. Done renders `a.kh-btn.pri` "Open channel" with `href=roomHref`.
5. `invite_failed` renders `role="alert"` and **Retry**.
6. No element has the class `kh-fin-x`.
7. The `font-family` of `h1.kh-fin-n` does not contain Bungee. Check `getComputedStyle` in a browser test, or assert no `wm` class in the unit test.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web test`
- `pnpm typecheck`

**Done when:** the confirm page matches the agent-finish card in both themes at 1440 and 390, and KM-134's behaviour tests still pass.

## Risks and stop conditions

- If KM-134's markup lacks a hook needed for a state (for example no `roomHref` prop), stop and ask. Do not change the controller.

## Complexity rationale

1: a presentational restyle of one component.
